purpose: Program flow in a small repo: when do rules fire. It is close to the Thue fish, so I want to see how it is written.

pages.title: isaactoslow1313/when-do-rules
pages.reaction: A WHEN/DO rule engine pitched as deterministic, with a lot of marketing gloss over a thin core. The real question is how rules fire, and the page mostly says it should be trustworthy. Useful as a vocabulary for my own repo, less so as code I can read.

pages.title: zfdang/remote-buddy
pages.reaction: A voice-input remote for macOS, written in Chinese with a real README and a lot of hardware detail. I wanted program flow when rules fire, and this is a product page for a microphone button, so it gave me little. The bit about mapping button presses to shortcuts is the closest thing to a rule engine here, and it is …

pages.title: Open-Less/openless
pages.reaction: A voice-to-text app that turns speech into prompts. Useful, but the trip was about program flow and rules firing, and this is a dictation tool with a lot of marketing.
